usage: policy to ensure only users with emails from the orgs listed have access to the repo
name: Access to repo should be limited to internal users
description: Only authorized users from within the organization should have ongoing access to the repo.
detailedDescription: External users having access to your repo greatly increases the risk of an account compromise. On compromise malicious actors will try to do a supply chain attack by introducing malicious code that will run as part of your app.

args.name: domains
args.label: Email Domains (Suffix)
args.tooltip: Choose the email domains that should have access to the build systems.

args.name: alwaysRejectDomains
args.label: Email Rejects (Suffix)
args.tooltip: Choose the email domains that should never have access to the build systems.

args.name: repoType
args.label: Repo Type
args.tooltip: Choose if the policy applies to private, public or all repo types.
